name: Imperial Dragon
description: The Dragon Emperor strikes with regal authority. Its Stamina-based endurance outlasts every challenger while its Dragon Breath burns through Defense.

ability.name: Dragon Emperor
ability.description: Each Stamina win heals 30 HP and restores +1 Stamina. Every 3 consecutive wins: grants +20 permanent Special boost, a 40 HP shield, and +15 DEF for 2 turns. When HP drops below 40% for the first time, Dragon's Last Stand triggers: +30 ATK and true damage for 3 turns.

special_move.name: Dragon Breath
special_move.description: A sustained torrent of draconic spin energy that scorches the opponent!
